source.title: Changes in the Board of Directors - November 2017
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

Another anonymous election took place among the voting members of the WCA for director positions. We hereby inform you on the results and the corresponding changes in the WCA Board of Directors.

We are happy to announce that the WCA Board has two new members: [Bob Burton](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2003BURT01) and [Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2011FIOL01), and [Chris Hardwick](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2003HARD01) is stepping down from being in the Board of Directors. We thank Chris for his work for the WCA and our community. He has served on the WCA Board since July 2016 and has put in a lot of time and effort to develop the WCA. He will still remain leader of the WCA Financial Committee and a WCA Delegate for Georgia, USA.

These changes have become effective starting November 9th, 2017.

All three candidates gave permission to publish their application documents which can be viewed here:
<https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/199Gr_MmpepvFwx36vVtpb_fnTnB-rfDR?usp=sharing>

translation.title: WCA 董事会成员变动（2017 年 11 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 有投票权的成员再次以无记名方式进行了董事选举，现公布结果及董事会的相应变动。

我们很高兴地宣布，[Bob Burton](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2003BURT01) 和 [Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2011FIOL01) 加入 WCA 董事会；[Chris Hardwick](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2003HARD01) 则将卸任董事。感谢 Chris 为 WCA 和社区所做的工作。他自 2016 年 7 月起担任董事，为 WCA 发展投入了大量时间和精力。他将继续担任 WCA 财务委员会负责人及美国佐治亚州的 WCA 代表。

上述变动自 2017 年 11 月 9 日起生效。

三位候选人均同意公开申请材料，可在此查看：
<https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/199Gr_MmpepvFwx36vVtpb_fnTnB-rfDR?usp=sharing>
